The plan lives in the operator checkout (/Users/akamel/Documents/AuditorAI) and is read-only; docs/RSA-Documents/track-a-sources.json remains the Track A source list of record and this file is the round-2 list of record.
note: Round 2 is Track A with a wider net: the same rules (public, free, no-login, robots-permitted, <=1 req/s per host), a different discovery channel. TWO channels are used and the committed candidate list records which one found each URL. (1) enumeration: the repo's own robots-checked listing strategies, run by scripts/harvest-round2-discover.ts - fully repeatable. (2) operator-discovery-pass: the candidate URLs were located in the operator's discovery pass, which used agent-reach's documented Jina Reader channel over a search engine. That channel is NOT usable by the committed pipeline: r.jina.ai's robots.txt allows only named AI user-agents (Claude-User, ChatGPT-User, ...) and disallows User-agent: *, and the harvest UA (AuditorAI-RSA-Harvest/1.0) is neutral and matches none of them. Every candidate is fetched by the harvester from its ORIGIN host under the robots, rate, hash and licence gates either way. NOTE on the `host` field: it is the host the source TALKS TO during discovery, not the host the documents live on. A search source talks to one search host and finds documents on many others; the licence and the province of each candidate are resolved from the candidate's own host (host_licences / province_hints below), which is why the `host` field here is the discovery host.

split_rule.quarantine: documents whose licence verdict is not CLEAR are never train and never test
split_rule.note: mirrors docs/RSA-Documents/track-a-sources.json and scripts/harvest-track-a.ts:38 (TEST_PROVINCES = QC, AB). The ticket's phrase 'the held-out prairie province' is read as Alberta per the code; Manitoba is NOT harvested in round 2 and stays in the gaps table (split-rule conflict flagged for the owner).

hash_rule.note: A document whose sha256 is already in the union of those three sets is never written to disk and never enters the intake manifest. The gate runs AFTER the bytes arrive: such a document is downloaded in full and then discarded, never re-ingested. The candidate log records it as dedupe_status=hash-already-present.

byte_cap.note: The 5 GB cap is cumulative over the corpus on the runner, not per round; a single document may not exceed 100 MiB. Both are enforced before any byte is written to disk.
